procedures: Coronary Artery Bypass Graft x3 (LIMA to LAD, SVG to OM1, SVG to RCA)
discharge_profile.dietary_instructions: Heart-healthy, low sodium (<2,000 mg/day). Fluid intake between 1.5L and 2.0L daily.
discharge_profile.activity_restrictions: Sternal precautions for 6 weeks: Do not lift, push, or pull anything heavier than 10 lbs. Hug heart pillow when coughing.
discharge_profile.wound_care_instructions: Keep chest sternal and saphenous vein harvest incisions clean and dry. Wash gently with mild soap. Do not soak in tub or pool.

medications.indication: Blood pressure and heart rate control post-CABG
medications.warning: Do not stop abruptly without physician instruction.

medications.indication: Antiplatelet therapy to maintain bypass graft patency

medications.warning: Critical antiplatelet. Report black stools or unusual bleeding.
DO NOT TAKE NSAIDs. Use prescribed Acetaminophen for mild pain.

red_flag_warnings: Chest pain, pressure, tightness, or pain radiating to left arm or jaw
Fever of 101.5°F (38.6°C) or higher, chills, or night sweats
Redness, swelling, heat, or persistent discharge from chest or leg incision
Clicking, popping, or shifting sensation in the breastbone (sternum)
Shortness of breath not relieved by rest or accompanied by coughing pink phlegm
Rapid weight gain of 3 lbs or more within 24 hours

initial_care_tasks_day_2.title: Morning Cardioprotective Medications
initial_care_tasks_day_2.description: Take Metoprolol 50mg and Aspirin 81mg with food and a glass of water.

initial_care_tasks_day_2.title: Morning Vitals & Weight Log
initial_care_tasks_day_2.description: Log your resting blood pressure, pulse, and dry morning weight after using the bathroom.

initial_care_tasks_day_2.title: Sternal & Leg Incision Inspection
initial_care_tasks_day_2.description: Check incision for warmth, unusual redness, or drainage. Clean gently if instructed.

initial_care_tasks_day_2.title: Incentive Spirometer Breathing Exercise
initial_care_tasks_day_2.description: 10 slow, deep inhalations using incentive spirometer to prevent lung atelectasis.

initial_care_tasks_day_2.title: Evening Antiplatelet (Plavix 75mg)
initial_care_tasks_day_2.description: Take Clopidogrel 75mg. Essential for bypass graft protection.
